description: Infrastructures de recharge pour (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération du Pays de Grasse. These data make it possible to locate and know the technical characteristics of stations and recharging points for electric vehicles open to the public, belonging to the Community of Agglomeration of the Pays de Grasse (CAPG) and located in its territory. Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération du Pays de Grasse. The portal shows the English title as "Charging infrastructure for electric vehicles (EVRI)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'agglomération du Pays de Grasse. Its keywords include vehicule-electrique, borne-de-recharge, mobility, electrical-charge, irve, deplacement. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
